business_summary: Kitagawa Seiki Co.,Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of press machines, laminators, factory automation equipment, and transfer machines in Japan, China, Malaysia, Thailand, and internationally. The company offers press machines for laminating copper-clad laminates and printed circuit boards; high temperature vacuum press machines; test press machines; prepreg cutting machines; and press machines for laminating IC cards. It also provides storage shelf for heavy goods, such as steel material; transport automation equipment specialized for various sites; floor lift; and automated warehouse. In addition, the company offers carbon fiber reinforced thermoplastic resin automatic stacking machines; and laminators for solar panels and other laminators. The company was formerly known as Kotobuki Seisakusho Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Kitagawa Seiki Co.,Ltd. in September 1960. Kitagawa Seiki Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1957 and is headquartered in Fuchu, Japan.
